name: This Little Life
source: This Little Life is a small kinetic visual novel made by Team Awkward Smile telling the story of a cold stormy winter night, where an on-duty Grimm reaper has her panties stolen by a mischievous cat.
translation: 《这个小生命》是一部由Awkward Smile团队制作的小型动态视觉小说，讲述了一个寒冷的暴风雨冬夜的故事，值班的格林收割者的内裤被一只顽皮的猫偷走了。
